title: Jonah and the Will
author: Rafael Voss
blurb: Paloma Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
